title: Don't include errno.h if we don't use errno or errno value definitions.

notes.body: Fails compilation on Rocky Linux 8, maybe others, because this uses `errno.h`

That's built on Linux iff we found libnl.  Perhaps the buildbot doesn't have the libnl development package install.

(I think this means that, without libnl, you won't have Wireshark automatically live-update the interface lists if interfaces get added.)

> Perhaps the buildbot doesn't have the libnl development package install.

No, but maybe the headers we include on some versions of some Linux distributions happen to include errno.h and the headers we include on other don't.
